paragraphs.en: My first love is the braid. When I see a woman with braided hair, a beautiful hairstyle, I fall in love. Like now, I'm in love with these braids.
paragraphs.zh: 我最喜欢的就是编辫子。当我看见一个编着辫子、发型美丽的姑娘，我会坠入爱河。现在，我依然很爱辫子。

paragraphs.en: They're well twisted. They're beautiful. So, when my client goes home today, the love that I feel in my heart will be the same love in the heart of her husband.
paragraphs.zh: 它们盘绕得很好，非常漂亮。当我的客户今天回家时，她们的丈夫也会像我一样爱她们。

paragraphs.en: Braiding is my job and my life revolves around braids. As soon as I touch someone's hair, I start braiding automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 编辫子是我的工作，我的生活围绕着编发进行。一旦我触碰到别人的头发，我就会自动开始编发。

paragraphs.en: While braiding, I think about my problems, the solutions, my future projects.
paragraphs.zh: 编辫子的时候，我会想我的问题，解决方法和未来的计划。

paragraphs.en: He learned a lot during his childhood. When our hair was not made, he was the one who would braid us.
paragraphs.zh: 他小时候学到了很多东西。在我们还不会梳头发的时候，是他帮我们编辫子。

paragraphs.en: At the time, there was a popular hairstyle called Kara in Bamako and everyone wanted Salian to braid their hair with this style.
paragraphs.zh: 当时，在巴马科流行一种名为Kara的发型，每个人都想让萨利安给他们编这种发型。

paragraphs.en: At first, I was told that it was a curse for a boy to braid hair, which made me have some doubts. Does my religion accept this profession?
paragraphs.zh: 起初，我被告知男孩编发是种诅咒，这让我产生了一些疑虑。我的宗教是否接受这个职业？

paragraphs.en: I kept questioning myself even when I was learning how to braid and starting my own business. When he braids your hair, you can feel the love.
paragraphs.zh: 即使在学习如何编发和创业的时候，我也一直在问自己。当他为你编发时，你能感受到那份爱。

paragraphs.en: He's not just doing your hair. He's making you look more beautiful. This is the first time I've had a man braid my hair.
paragraphs.zh: 他不只是在给你做头发，他是在让你变得更漂亮。这是我第一次让一个男人给我编头发。

paragraphs.en: When he said he's going to braid my hair, I said, 'Oh my God, I'm about to have a power drill on my head.'
paragraphs.zh: 当他说要给我编辫子时，我说：“天啊，这是要把电钻放我头上吧。”

paragraphs.en: But he's more softer than it is when working with the women. Because I have seen some mean women with their mean vice grips on top of my head.
paragraphs.zh: 但其实他比女性的手法还要温柔。因为我曾见过一些刻薄的女性用她们粗暴的钳子捯饬我的头发。

paragraphs.en: I can't even tell that he's in my hair compared to the women. Every time he did a braid, I touched the braid that he does and it actually feels perfect.
paragraphs.zh: 跟女性的手法相比，我甚至感受不到他在动我的头发。每次他编完之后我都会摸摸他编的辫子，手感真的完美。

paragraphs.en: I'd say, it's about 700 a month. So, it's 700 times 12. I spend a lot of money.
paragraphs.zh: 我每个月大概花700美元在我头发上，一年就是700乘12，我花了很多钱。

paragraphs.en: This job is not just about the money. It's about putting joy in people's hearts. It's a positive energy that you can give to someone who is depressed.
paragraphs.zh: 这份工作不只是为了钱。它是为了给人们的心中带去欢乐。这可以给沮丧的人带来正能量。

paragraphs.en: It helped me learn about other people and other cultures. Every time I braid, I discover something new.
paragraphs.zh: 它帮助我了解其他人以及其他文化。每次编辫子时，我都会有新的发现。

paragraphs.en: Salian has been coming here for more than like 15 years actually. He's kind of like family. I don't feel any hesitation.
paragraphs.zh: 萨里安来这里已经超过15年了。他就像家人一样。我没有丝毫犹豫。

paragraphs.en: I'm very confident in being able to send my customers over there and they're going to be treated well. He helps me, I help him.
paragraphs.zh: 我非常有信心把我的客户送到那里去，他们会接受很好的服务。我们互相帮助。

paragraphs.en: Like, he tells me, 'Christine, you've got to put this product because you know this works really well because sometimes we don't know either.
paragraphs.zh: 他跟我说：“克里斯汀，你得推广这款产品，因为它效果真的很好，毕竟有时候我们自己也不清楚。”

paragraphs.en: To my friends who laughed at me when I was little, I would like to say to them today, 'Your teasing encouraged me to be better.'
paragraphs.zh: 对于那些小时候嘲笑我的朋友们，我今天想对他们说：“你们的取笑激励我变得更好。”

paragraphs.en: The little boy has become a great hair braider. My only advice to any parent or anyone who sees someone doing something out of the ordinary, is to never make fun of them.
paragraphs.zh: 这个小男孩已经成为了一名出色的发型师。我给予任何父母或任何看到有人在做不寻常事情的人的唯一建议是，永远不要取笑他们。

paragraphs.en: There are no foolish jobs. There are only foolish people.
paragraphs.zh: 世上没有愚蠢的工作，只有愚蠢的人。
